items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-06-06
items.q: And this is Sidney Hansel, another New Orleans boy. He was the vocalist. ... We used all these instruments that you see here.

ctx.x: Edmund. I met Edmund once. I don't know him real well but I remember he had a Jaguar car.

Now this fellow, you recognize him? That's Cartrell. That's correct. This fellow you wouldn't know. He is from a little town in Louisiana, Lake Charles. This is Frank Jack here, the trombonist. Uh huh. You notice there's only one trombone in this band before the band increased. It was only three brass. Two trumpets and a trombone. This is Al Freeman from Columbus, Ohio.
